signals.definition: buyer pain signal observed from public-read, repo-internal, or owner-approved future evidence
signals.confidence_rules: T0/T1 internal evidence is weaker than T2+ public evidence; direct owner-approved external evidence is stronger but absent in E65.
signals.update_rules: append new evidence atom, update route confidence, rerun scoring profile and sensitivity model
signals.scoring_effect: positive, negative, or uncertainty adjustment depending on route and evidence tier
signals.no_overclaim_boundary: never upgrade public-read or internal evidence into customer validation, paid signal, expert feedback, or global optimality
